observations: body L12, L27: the kasra under the wāw of «مُسْتَوِيَةٌ» (L12) touches the end of the tail of the wāw; in «مُسْتَوِيَة» (L27) it stands clear of the tail.
body L12, L25: the alif after the article in «الٱعْتِدَالِ» (L12) and «الٱسْتِوَاء» (L25) carries the waṣla (4.3 by 2.2 points); transcribed ٱ, as on pp. 327 and 330.
body L14, L29: the first digit of «٤٢» (L14) is a 4 (3.6 points), the second a 2 (2.9 points); the first digit of «٦١» (L29) has the hook of a 6 at its upper left (2.9 points).
body L18, L25: the final hamza of «السَّوَاء» (L18) and of «الٱسْتِوَاء» (L25) is the plain sort, its flat stroke on the baseline, without a vowel sign; «خَطُّ» (L25) has a damma above the shadda.
body L28: «ظِلّ» is printed with an elongated join (kashīda), not transcribed; the kasratan of «مُسْتَوٍ» touches the end of the tail of the wāw.
body L35: the gāf of the Persian «ڭويند» is printed as kāf with three dots above (ڭ), as on p. 335; the quotation continues on p. 340.
